# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My pick: JBL Charge 6.** It's rated IP68, which is dust-tight and built for immersion. It gets 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost) and can charge your phone. What Hi-Fi named it best overall, and Best Products did too. Prices in the results run from about $130 at Walmart to $150 at Amazon. ([What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart), [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/))

## Other good options

- **Pool party or loudest: JBL Boombox 4.** RTINGS ranks it the best waterproof speaker it has tested. It floats, handles long immersion, and lasts over 40 hours. It sounds muffled if you're to the side or behind it. No price was listed. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth))
- **Sound in every direction: Ultimate Ears EPICBOOM.** It's IP67 and floats, and its 360-degree sound suits people spread around the pool. Battery is about 15 hours. Tom's Guide picked it best overall. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth), [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers))
- **Budget: Ultimate Ears WONDERBOOM 4.** It's IP67, floats, and has 13–14 hours of battery. Best Products listed it at about $65. ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/))
- **Cheapest and tiny: JBL Go 5.** It's IP67 and about $40, but battery is only 8 hours. ([What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart))
- **Easy to carry: JBL Grip.** It's can-sized, IP68, and about $100, with 12 hours of battery. Good Housekeeping's top pick for the beach. ([Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/))
- **Big sound that floats: Soundcore Boom 2 Plus.** It's IPX7, floats, and gets up to 20 hours at half volume. The list price is $249.99, and the code AFSC20 brought it to $200 in a cart test on Oct 22 (the code expires Dec 31). It weighs 3.8 kg (about 8.4 lb), so it's heavy. [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-boom-2-plus))

## Beach and pool tips

- Look for at least IP67. For sand, the first number should be 5 or 6. An "X" (as in IPX7) means it wasn't tested for dust, so keep it on a towel. ([Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/))
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage. Rinse the speaker with fresh water after use and dry it fully before charging, if the manufacturer allows rinsing. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth))

The review pages above have retailer buy buttons, but I couldn't see direct retailer links in the results. Check the current price at checkout, since these change often.
